title: Active Hyperref GoTo link Contents and PDF-string subprofiles on the URL-deduplicated N=1,000 source

inputs.compile: One direct tagged LuaLaTeX pass from the same populated .aux and .toc seeds; no production convergence helper.

pdf_audit.method: pypdf page-order text extraction; NFC normalization; link signature counter over page index, rectangle, action and action target, and Contents; ParentTree entry matched to StructElem owning the OBJR for each Link annotation.

decision: Diagnostic only. Both profiles preserve all audited PDF semantics. The inner profile narrows the largest timed work to text purification and UTF-16 hex conversion. No renderer optimization is justified from one instrumented pass; any prototype must preserve accessible link Contents and be checked with repeated performance and structural audits.

profiles.method: A temporary TeX copy wraps the tag-aware hyp/link/GoTo/Contents socket, the internal PDF-string conversion macro, and link/GoTo Contents dictionary insertion. Lua os.clock accumulates inclusive CPU time around each operation.
profiles.interpretation: The GoTo Contents conversion and dictionary insertion occur inside the socket; destination-name conversion occurs earlier in link creation. Timers are diagnostic and include macro work inside each call; profiler wrapper overhead is not separately calibrated. Single instrumented pass; wall time is not comparable to uninstrumented build timings.

profiles.name: PDF-string encoder internals
profiles.method: A second temporary TeX copy wraps the current GoTo Contents PDF-string macro and its purification, string conversion, hex delimiters, and string assignments. Lua os.clock accumulates inclusive CPU time around each operation.
profiles.interpretation: Purification and UTF-16 hex conversion account for most of the timed PDF-string operation in this single instrumented run. Suboperation timers do not include their own wrapper overhead; enclosing timers do. The measurements are diagnostic, not paired performance results. Prefix and suffix timings are nested inside the string-conversion interval and must not be added to it.
